name: gc-minimal-ip-doodle
tagline_zh: 同一张脸反复画，五官不许漂
desc_en: Preserve an IP character's identity while redrawing it as a sparse, flat, hand-drawn sticker illustration on white or a light grainy background. Use for requests such as "把这个角色做成极简手绘风格", "生成五张不同生活场景", "做一个浅色背景轻颗粒版", "再来五张不要重复", or when a frog, capybara, fish, mascot, toy, or other character reference must become a consistent batch of cute deadpan doodles.
why_zh: 涂鸦可以松，脸必须认得出来。这件卖的是不漂，不是可爱。
limit_zh: 不是角色设定全集。要三视图、要服装表，另找。
